node.title: PMA three-petal mu-basis reduction
node.statement: For three pairwise-coprime monic degree-ell petal locators and distinct labels, the strict-strip contributor space is exactly the bounded syzygy module of the locator row. A reduced basis has degrees mu and ell-mu. Exact-defect saturation forces mu=s below the half strip and mu>=ell-s above it, so the lower branch has one projective candidate and the upper branch is a two-generator family whose coefficient-degree budget is e-1=2s-ell. The reconstructed basis-pair determinant is a nonzero scalar times L1L2L3, making saturation on core divisors equivalent to a primitive coefficient pair. This reduces the remaining M=4,t=3 branch to counting primitive pairs for which uFp+vFq is a split core divisor; it does not supply that growing-e count.
